# MM-P3-L4-RR01-S3 Calibration checks - Heat Treat radial ring rolling mill #1

Revision: Rev B  
Plant: P3, line P3-L4  
Equipment: EQ-P3-L4-RR01

Scope
- This procedure defines calibration check activities for Heat Treat radial ring rolling mill #1 (EQ-P3-L4-RR01) to verify geometric and control-system alignment before production of rings up to the maximum ring outer diameter for Heat Treat radial ring rolling mill #1 (EQ-P3-L4-RR01) is 1720 mm. Use this document in conjunction with SOP-P3-L4-02, SOP-P3-L4-03, and SOP-P3-L4-05.

Tools
- Dial indicators with magnetic bases suitable for mill spindle and carriage checks.  
- Straightedge and feeler gauges for guide way inspection.  
- Handheld alignment laser or optical target compatible with mill datum points.  
- Cleaning supplies and approved lubricant part number CFW-LUB-315.  
- Calibration log form from document control.

Procedure
- Prepare the machine following SOP-P3-L4-02 for lockout and safe access.  
- Clean measurement surfaces and datum faces per SOP-P3-L4-03.  
- Mount the alignment laser or optical target on the primary spindle datum and reference the carriage datum. Record relative positional offsets on the calibration log form.  
- Verify guide way straightness with the straightedge and feeler gauges along the working length; document any deviations found.  
- Check spindle runout with dial indicators on the intended ring mounting flange and record results. Use the calibration log form to capture each measurement and any corrective actions.  
- Apply lubricant where required before reassembly using lubricant part number CFW-LUB-315 per lubrication points specified in SOP-P3-L4-05.  
- Release machine from maintenance state following SOP-P3-L4-02 and confirm control setpoints are restored.

Acceptance criteria
- All documented measurement results must be within machine design allowances as specified in the equipment calibration baseline.  
- Any measurement outside baseline must be recorded, corrected, and rechecked before production of rings approaching the maximum ring outer diameter for Heat Treat radial ring rolling mill #1 (EQ-P3-L4-RR01) is 1720 mm.  
- Calibration log form must reference SOP-P3-L4-02, SOP-P3-L4-03, and SOP-P3-L4-05 and be filed in the equipment maintenance record.
